title: US Sauna & Cold Plunge Venue Data
subtitle: Cold plunge, sauna and contrast-therapy venues across US metros, each fact dated and sourced
description:
Cold plunge, sauna and contrast-therapy venues across the US metros that findsaunaplunge.com covers. Every record carries the date its details were last checked (lastVerified) and a status saying how. In venues.json every published temperature and price carries the page it came from, the date that page was read and a verbatim quote supporting it; a weekly recheck re-reads every source page.

An absent field means the venue does not publish that detail. It never means zero. pricing.priceFrom lists prices published only as floors ("from $29").

Files: venues.csv (one row per venue), venues.json (the feed as published, with per-fact sources), cities.json (metros covered), SNAPSHOT.md (date and headline counts).

The venues are those in the metros covered, not a national sample. Temperatures and prices are what venues publish, not measurements.

Live feed: https://findsaunaplunge.com/api/v1/venues.json (CC BY 4.0, no key). National summary with denominators: https://findsaunaplunge.com/data/us-sauna-cold-plunge/. Source repository and monthly releases: https://github.com/findsaunaplunge/data. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22132913. Licence CC BY 4.0; please attribute with a link to findsaunaplunge.com.
